p = h λ

questions.q: An electromagnetic wave is propagating along the <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">z</mi></math>-axis. Direction of electric and the magnetic field of this wave can be represented by
questions.solution:
The electromagnetic wave is propagating along the +z axis.
Since the electric and magnetic fields are perpendicular to each other and also perpendicular to the direction of propagation of wave.

Also, E⁡ → × B⁡ →  gives the direction of wave propagation.

E⁡ → = E⁡ 0 i⁡ ^ , B = B⁡ 0 j⁡ ^ ∵ i⁡ ^ × j⁡ ^ = k ^

questions.solution:
Given:
The distance of the moon ( s )=384000 km

=384000× 10 3  m

We known speed of light ( c )=3× 10 8  m/s

Total time taken by the laser beam to make the round trip is

t=2sc=2×384000×10003×108=2.5 s

questions.solution:

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: An electromagnetic wave of frequency <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">υ</mi><mo>=</mo><mtext>3.0 MHz</mtext></math> passes from vacuum into a dielectric medium with permittivity <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">ε</mi><mo>=</mo><mtext>4.0</mtext></math>. Then
options: wavelength is doubled and the frequency remains unchanged
wavelength is doubled and frequency becomes half
wavelength is halved and frequency remains unchanged
wavelength and frequency both remain unchanged
questions.solution:
During propagation of a wave from one medium to another, the frequency remains constant and wavelength changes.

μ=εε0=4=2

Since  μ∝1λ

∴ Wavelength is halved
Hence option (wavelength is halved and frequency remains unchanged) holds good.
